title: Effect of pre-treatment conditions on the electrochemical performance of hard carbon derived from bio-waste
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1105-1114
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08029G, Paper
Open Access

Oniye Modupe Mutiat, Aibar Alpysbayev, Dilshat Abduakhitov, Kenes Kudaibergenov, Zhumabay Bakenov, Seung-Taek Myung, Aishuak Konarov
This study examined the effect of the pretreatment on hard-carbon from coffee waste for sodium-ion batteries. Pre-oxidation at 150 °C showed 304 mA h g−¹ capacity and enhanced cycling stability.
